column1: # Cutter reference: 200 Vietnamese sentences cut into words, for tools/cutter_test.py (`make cutter`; a report, not a gate).
# WRITTEN AND CUT BY CLAUDE, NOT CHECKED BY A NATIVE SPEAKER. The sentences are Claude's own writing (18 Nov 2026):
# everyday Northern usage, taken from no source, CC0. They were cut by hand following docs/SEGMENTATION.md, without
# running any cutter on them first. The reference is one non-native model's judgement: its scores measure agreement
# with that judgement, not correctness. A native speaker should check it; attributed real sentences (Tatoeba) are to
# be added once our Tatoeba snapshot exists.
# (The earlier reference of 17 Nov 2026 used sentences of the Tatoeba Challenge copy, whose licence is in conflict:
# removed from the repository on 18 Nov 2026, see docs/HISTORY.md.)
# Format: one sentence per line, two tab-separated fields:
#   cut    the sentence with an underscore between the syllables of one word, spaces between words (as in lessons)
